Press Install Helper, which installs the helper APK this app carries. Only now, after the reboot, is it accepted as a system app. It needs no root: without one the install runs through Shizuku\'s shell.

The helper on the phone was built by a different version of this app, so it carries that version\'s shellcode: a run it starts is that build\'s run, and what this one fixed isn\'t on the phone yet. Installing replaces it in place - the package keeps the system uid it already has, and the copy in this APK is the only one this app can drive. It needs no root: without one the install runs through Shizuku\'s shell.

The helper\'s code runs inside the system process, which is already up, so a Reboot is what makes it load what was just installed rather than the copy it has in memory. On a first install it is also the boot that puts its system user into effect.
